non_goals: Not a proof that arbitrary actions admit undo-law or that arbitrary metadata payloads are populated or truthful.
Not a FHIR deployment, access-control implementation, NIST compliance proof, retention proof, or cryptographic append-only log.
Not a proof that HoTT has no reality-relative paradox or that the full T1 task is complete.
